payload.notes: Root cause of t06_load_store failures: load byte/half selection ignored the low address bits. LB/LBU always took dmem_rdata[7:0] and LH/LHU only used addr[1], so byte loads at addr[1:0]!=0 returned the wrong lane (x4..x8, x19, x23 all got 0x01/0x00 instead of the stored byte). Fix: compute load_byte via a 4-way mux on em_alu_result[1:0] (little-endian lane select) and load_half via addr[1], then apply sign/zero extension per funct3. This also corrects t06b_neg_imm and the crc32 benchmark which depend on correct byte/half loads. Store path (SB/SH byte enables and replicated wdata) was already correct and is unchanged.
